# RxLabs®

> A research laboratory for artificial intelligence, neurotechnology and operating systems for heap-0 neuromorphic robotic runtimes. Non-profit organisation. Running code, public evidence and figures that can be measured again.

In the future, RxLabs® will become a real company, a Spanish limited company (S.L.), to build autonomous drones with echoAI and echOS.

Site: https://rxlabs.org/en
Documentation: https://rxlabs.org/en/docs
Contact: knightsys@proton.me
Discord: https://discord.gg/rxlabs
Complete text: https://rxlabs.org/en/llms-full.txt

## Projects

- **echOS 3.0** — edge robotics unikernel with a sensor→intent pipeline, safety gate and PX4 bridge. [Page](https://www.rxlabs.org/en/echos) · [Docs](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/echos/que-es)
- **PRISMA** — EEG analysis for research with an event-driven Rust engine. [Page](https://www.rxlabs.org/en/prisma) · [Docs](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/prisma/resumen)
  - Exploratory intent → drone campaign: EEG, EMG and body control compared as sources of bounded intents that echoAI and echOS filter before the flight controller. No results of our own, no sensors, no drone; it does not read thoughts. [Campaign](https://www.rxlabs.org/en/docs/prisma/eeg-dron)
- **echoAI** — two-clock situated agent with a 16-byte WSP, CAM, T, Q and gate. ECHO-1 and ECHO-2 are closed; ECHO-3 has 13 of 15 software certificates; TRANSFER-3 is red and DRONE-3 is pending. [Page](https://www.rxlabs.org/en/echoai) · [Docs](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/echoai/que-es)

## ECHO-3 now

ECHO-3 has **13 of 15 milestones with green certificates within their software scope**. ECHO-1 and ECHO-2 are closed; the robotics programme remains open. Components have been tested with controls and audits, but adding certificates does not demonstrate an integrated mission in a physical robot.

**TRANSFER-3** must demonstrate useful improvement from learning in A on new environments, against the same agent without that experience, without carrying a map or solution. It is red with no candidate. The gain school learns exactly, but the latest safe B3 pilot reaches 51/72 against nominal's 52/72 and costs more including school. It did not advance to prospective confirmation or open real B/C.

**DRONE-3** must integrate the complete mission with causal traceability in SITL, HIL and a cage. Link, energy and safety certificates do not replace that joint closure. Instrumented battery, latency under load and combined faults must be checked during integration. The laboratory has no robotics hardware or Akida; HIL and cage work require that platform.

- [Article: ECHO-3 has passed halfway](https://rxlabs.org/en/articulos/echo3-a-mitad)
- [Roadmap](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/echoai/ruta)

- [Architecture](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/echoai/piezas)

Results describe defined test banks. Do not attribute general autonomy, physical hardware or an LLM in echoAI’s fast loop.
